method: Independent model source review; tests executed separately by implementation agent

findings.title: Unauthenticated actor binding check permits guest session hijacking
findings.reproduction: Create a session as guest (authenticated_user_id: null). Any other unauthenticated guest sharing or acquiring capability/session reference satisfies actorMatches because null === null.
findings.fix: Bind guest sessions to an unforgeable guest actor token or unique client/device identity rather than evaluating null === null as an actor match.

findings.title: Upstash Redis backend compares stale state_version in CAS script
findings.reproduction: MUTATE_SCRIPT verifies record.state_version against ARGV[8] (current.state_version fetched in pre-read). A concurrent CAS between read and eval still passes if ARGV[3] matches, but if ARGV[3] != ARGV[8] it fails unnecessarily, or if concurrent mutations interleave, ARGV[8] causes false conflicts.
findings.fix: Rely only on expected_state_version (ARGV[3]) in MUTATE_SCRIPT and remove the redundant check against pre-read state_version (ARGV[8]).

limitations: External modules (flags.ts, memory-extractor.ts, memory-repository.ts, orchestrator.ts, types.ts) were not provided.

findings.title: Unchecked allergy modification on edit endpoint creates unvalidated food allergy claims
findings.reproduction: Call PUT /me/ai-memory/edit with selector `{ memory_type: 'allergy', memory_key: 'peanut', source: 'explicit' }` and food `'strawberries'`. `slugifyFoodKey` delegates to `normalizeAllergen('strawberries')`, which returns null for unknown allergens and falls back to slugifying 'strawberries'. The fact is directly inserted with memory_type 'allergy' without validating against verified allergen lists.
findings.fix: Validate food with `normalizeAllergen(food)` when `input.selector.memory_type === 'allergy'`. Reject the update if `normalizeAllergen` returns null.

findings.title: Edit memory fact deletes old entry without optimistic epoch fence, risking silent overwrite races
findings.reproduction: Client submits PUT /me/ai-memory/edit without passing `expected_memory_epoch` in `selector`. `deleteFact` invokes `concierge_v2_delete_memory_fact_fenced` with a null epoch, bypassing CAS protection against concurrent user forget/disable actions that occurred between UI read and submit.
findings.fix: Require `expected_memory_epoch` in editSchema's selector, passing it into `tx.deleteFact`, or verify `settings.memory_epoch === input.selector.expected_memory_epoch` before deleting.

limitations: External modules (food-safety.ts, redact.ts, contracts/concierge-v2.ts) are not fully provided.
Database runtime environment and complete database schemas outside the provided migrations were not directly executed.

findings.title: Handoff fails when draft review state transition is skipped
findings.reproduction: Create draft via draft_operation or intent. In chot/review turn, request action handoff_draft. Draft review_state is still 'building'. prepareCartHandoff checks draft.review_state !== 'ready_for_review' and throws INVALID_HANDOFF.
findings.fix: Before invoking prepareCartHandoff on handoff_draft, call transitionDraftReviewState(checked, 'ready_for_review') or update checkDraftHandoffEligibility / prepareCartHandoff to permit auto-transition if valid.

findings.title: Natural language item removal removes wrong line or corrupts notes
findings.reproduction: Have two cart lines for dishId with notes 'ít cay' and 'không cay'. In UI/consumer, call remove(dishId) without note. In cartReducer REMOVE_ITEM, condition (item.note ?? '') !== (action.note ?? '') evaluates against note=undefined, filtering out only lines where note==='', deleting empty-note items or failing to match target line.
findings.fix: Pass note from caller or update cartReducer REMOVE_ITEM and UPDATE_QUANTITY to check if action.note !== undefined before filtering by note.

findings.title: Direct draft_operation ignores pending suggestions validation
findings.reproduction: Client sends draft_operation={type: 'add_item', pending_suggestion_id: 'x', menu_item_id: 'y', quantity: 1}. orchestrator passes undefined for allowedPendingSuggestionIds to applyDraftBatch, bypassing allowed suggestion verification for operations not passing through lines 94-98.
findings.fix: Pass next.pending_suggestion_ids as the 4th argument to applyDraftBatch instead of undefined.

limitations: External schemas, contracts (@contracts/concierge-v2), and DB pool/migrations were not provided.
RAG, memory extraction/retrieval implementations, and LLM orchestration delegates were not provided.

dispositions.title: Unauthenticated actor binding check permits guest session hijacking
dispositions.reason: Actor binding checks user ID, but session-store.ts enforces 256-bit unforgeable bearer capability verification in isAuthorized via SHA-256 hash match on all reads, mutations, and deletions.

dispositions.title: Upstash Redis backend compares stale state_version in CAS script
dispositions.reason: Comparing record.state_version against both expected_state_version and pre-read state_version prevents applying mutations based on a stale pre-read serialization payload.

dispositions.title: Unchecked allergy modification on edit endpoint creates unvalidated food allergy claims
dispositions.reason: Allergy memory stores user constraints rather than verified kitchen claims. evaluateFoodSafety treats unmapped/unknown allergen keys as unverified/unknown and blocks safe claims fail-closed.

dispositions.title: Edit memory fact deletes old entry without optimistic epoch fence, risking silent overwrite races
dispositions.reason: customerFactSelectorSchema requires expected_memory_epoch; memory-handlers.ts and concierge_v2_delete_memory_fact_fenced enforce epoch CAS validation under a row lock.

dispositions.title: Handoff fails when draft review state transition is skipped
dispositions.reason: Draft specification mandates explicit review step (via 'chot' or review_draft) to enter 'ready_for_review' before cart handoff; direct handoff from 'building' is intentionally disallowed.

dispositions.title: Natural language item removal removes wrong line or corrupts notes
dispositions.reason: CartDrawer.tsx now checks `item.note === undefined` and forwards `item.note` to onUpdateQuantity and onRemoveItem.

dispositions.title: Direct draft_operation ignores pending suggestions validation
dispositions.reason: orchestrator.ts lines 94-98 validate pending_suggestion_id against pending_items on incoming draft_operation before applyDraftBatch.

limitations: Unprovided modules (context.ts, session-summary.ts, tool-registry.ts, menu-retrieval.ts, llm-config.ts, draft-cart.ts, memory-extractor.ts, memory-repository.ts, memory-retrieval.ts) were not directly inspected.
External provider model quality, hosted Upstash Redis infrastructure, and human accessibility (WCAG/screen readers) remain unverified.
